# K06 (condition)
# generated by gen_views.py; sources: elements.jsonl 95570c1f441443df

The site sets what members can do, and members report its faults and pass on fixes. They report a blank or stale canvas, the site down, a vanished or faulty timer, glitches that seem to give extra pixels, captchas, the official app required and the site blocked in a country. They refresh, update, keep a separate window and test whether extra pixels reach the canvas.
